description.value: A fee campsite on Mosaic Forest Management private timberland in the Caycuse watershed, accessed via active logging roads south of Lake Cowichan — a utilitarian forest stop with no confirmed amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Caycuse Campsite is real and active (2026 reservations open, listed under South Island campsites), operated by Silvifor Resource Consultants Ltd. on Mosaic Forest Management land, consistent with OSM tags. The fetched pages rendered mostly navigation and boilerplate — the Caycuse-specific booking page did not surface amenity details — so nearly all optional amenities must be null. Reservations accepted is confirmed true from the booking URL structure and 'Reservations for 2026 are now open' banner.
concerns: No physical address in OSM record — location is lat/lon only.
No phone number in OSM or on website pages fetched.
Caycuse-specific booking/amenity page rendered only navigation and boilerplate — no site-level amenity details could be extracted. A JavaScript-heavy booking widget likely blocked content rendering.
Campsite is accessed via active logging roads; road conditions and access may be variable for cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable campsite on Mosaic Forest Management land with online reservations open for 2026. A useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact email found on off-season page: campsites@silvifor.com. Website applies a pack-in, pack-out policy for off-season rentals; likely applies during regular season as well.

wow_evidence: active logging roads ... no confirmed amenities
